Lina (CS): FYI we saw a spike of failed onboarding jobs for EU tenants starting ~08:12 UTC. Cause looks like an automated key-rotation that touched session tokens for new installs. Need a short customer-facing note + renewal-risk callouts.
Omar (Eng): confirmed root cause: scheduled HSM key rotation triggered earlier than expected, edge case in rotation handler caused 401s for token refresh in new sessions. Rollback and workaround applied at 08:40 UTC; fix deployed 09:05 UTC.
Eva (Solutions): good to know. For outreach we should: 1) call out exact window (08:129:05 UTC), 2) give concrete remediation steps for customers who saw failures, 3) offer replay assistance and optional credit.
Sergio (Acct Mgmt): I have four mid-enterprise renewals in the next 45 days; want a standard escalation paragraph we can drop into renewal threads so CSMs can proactively manage churn risk.
Lina (CS): draft for review below. Keep it short and actionable.
Lina (CS): ```
Hi {CustomerName},
We want to make you aware of a short incident on {date} between 08:129:05 UTC that affected onboarding for some EU tenants. New installs or webhook deliveries created during that window may have failed due to an accelerated key rotation.
Impact: failed onboarding attempts and 401 token-refresh errors for new sessions. Existing active sessions and previously onboarded data were not impacted.
What we did: we rolled back the premature rotation, deployed a safety fix to the rotation handler, and validated replays for queued events.
How we can help now:
- If you attempted a new onboarding during the window, we can replay missed payloads on your behalf.
- To replay yourself: 
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/replay -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{\"tenant_id\": \"<tenant>\"}'
- We will surface an audit of any failed attempts to your account.
We99re also offering a targeted credit for customers materially impacted; reply to this message to request assistance or a 1:1.
Sincerely,
Lina & the Redwood CS team
```
Omar (Eng): nit: add a single-line link to status page and incident ID for transparency.
Lina (CS): done. Added: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2026-03-21-key-rotation-eu (Incident ID: 2026-03-21-KEYROT-EU).
Eva (Solutions): Sergio, for renewals language try this short blurb for renewals threads: "Incident impact window noted; Redwood offering tailored replay assistance and a goodwill credit (range: $500-$2,000 depending on severity). Please let us know if you'd like a joint meeting with engineering."
Sergio (Acct Mgmt): perfect. I'll attach an addendum per-account: for the two highest-risk renewals offer the upper band and a 30-min technical walk-through.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-KEYROT-EU: status -> RESOLVED. Monitor -> 24h.
